body:
blocked: waiting on unimplemented `#1958` prerequisite `#1962` on `upstream/main`.

Checked `upstream/main` at `c86d6db35` and all open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- `#1965` (AC IK solver in `crates/post/src/kinematics/`) merged via PR `#2056` (`7a83b6751`).
- `#1962` (`Define AC trunnion kinematics fields and non-RTCP flag in .mch schema`) is still **open** with no open PR:
  - `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs` (`Machine`, `AxisLimits`) and `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` (`collect_axes`, `parse_mch_with`) still flatten `axes` sorted by `ctrl_coord` (dropping parent-child rotary nesting order) and do not yet define or parse rotary `pivot`, child `offset`, `zero_offset`, `rollover`, rotary sign convention (`table_rh` / `tool_rh`), or `controller.rtcp`.
  - `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs` still infers `rtcp` geometrically from rotary tilt, and `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs` does not yet validate trunnion schema fields.
- Related `#1958` sub-issues `#1969` (post-IK trajectory checks in `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs` and `mod.rs`) and `#1970` (setup WCS-to-pivot offset and sample XYZAC `.mch`) are also open and labeled `blocked` waiting on `#1962` (and `#1966`/`#1968`).

Without `#1962` on `upstream/main`, `crates/app/src/fixture.rs` (`rotary_axis_of`), `crates/app/src/posting_swing_standing.rs`, and `crates/app/src/posting_index_swing.rs` have no `.mch` tree nesting order or real `(A, C)` pivot/offset fields on `Machine` to read, so `#1973` cannot match the `.mch` tree or verify non-zero pivot positions in the posting gate without duplicating `#1962`.

Overlap notes for when `#1973` is unblocked:
- No open PR currently touches `crates/sim/src/verify/workholding.rs`, `crates/sim/src/verify/posed_steel.rs`, `crates/sim/src/verify/mesh_posed.rs`, `crates/app/src/fixture.rs`, `crates/app/src/fixture_struck.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting_swing_standing.rs`, or `crates/app/src/posting_index_swing.rs`.
- Open PRs `#1713`, `#1738`, `#1817`, `#1954`, `#2013`, `#2035`, and `#2037` touch `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`; `#1738` also touches `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`.

Stopped before claiming (`#1973` left open and unclaimed; no branch, worktree, code change, or PR created). Drop `blocked` once `#1962` (and any needed setup/IK trajectory plumbing from `#1969`/`#1970`) merges to `main`.
